items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: He was very kind, but he was also going with the Countess Johnson, who I worked with later, see?

ctx.x: The one that he liked the best of all? I gave that to him. He was very kind, but he was also going with the Countess Johnson, who I worked with later, see? When I started working down there opposite them, on 12th Street, then he started going with the Countess. And so then--
Well, now, Countess Johnson, who was she?
